test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The Smiths have put up a huge Christmas tree.

options.text: A huge Christmas tree is being put up by the Smiths.
A huge Christmas tree has been put up by the Smiths.
A huge Christmas tree is put up by the Smiths.
A huge Christmas tree was put up by the Smiths.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'A huge Christmas tree has been put up by the Smiths.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows: 
 
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *We have finalized the site for our new factory. (Active Voice) *
 
• *The site for our new factory has been finalized by us. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The Smiths' and the object of the given sentence is 'A huge Christmas tree'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• And 'have put up' will be changed into 'has been put up'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *A huge Christmas tree has been put up by the Smiths.*
